title: BACE: Safety & Workplace Culture - Biotechnology - Disinfection
subject: Biotechnology

questions.q: What is the minimum recommended contact time for a 10% bleach solution to effectively deactivate most vegetative bacteria and viruses on a surface?
questions.explain: While bleach acts quickly, protocols (like CDC BMBL) generally recommend a contact time of at least 10 to 20 minutes (depending on the specific pathogen) to ensure complete disinfection before wiping the surface dry.
